rule: Append-only. The V2 receipt keeps its preimages and postimages as written. Each chain starts at a V2 postimage and ends at the live file. A 'receipt' step is sealed by that receipt's target for the same path (pre -> post); a 'drop-product-prefix' step is a rename_types.py carry whose new bytes equal the previous bytes with the M3 prefix of the renamed types dropped (values also appended to m3/tooling/jdk-naming/RENAME_RESEAL.tsv). The semantic-census job checks every step and the live SHA-256.
